title: Wellness Membership Freezes
content:
An active Wellness Membership may be frozen for a set period, within the limits of its tier.

## The clause

Only an active membership is frozen, where the tier allows freezes, for at least the tier's shortest freeze and at most the tier's longest freeze in calendar days, and at most the tier's number of freezes per membership year, the membership year being counted from the start date. A medical freeze needs a physician's or therapist's note. Where the tier adds frozen months to the commitment, the commitment end date moves out by the whole months frozen. A freeze cannot be requested while dues are past due.

## Conditions, one by one

| Condition | Met when |
|---|---|
| Status | the membership is active |
| Freeze available | the tier allows freezes |
| Length | the freeze is not shorter than the tier's shortest freeze and not longer than its longest freeze, in calendar days |
| Frequency | the freezes in the current membership year, counted from the start date and including this one, do not exceed the tier's number per membership year |
| Dues | dues are not past due |
| Medical freeze only | a physician's or therapist's note supports it |

## Effect

While frozen, the membership has the status frozen; when the freeze ends, the membership returns to active and billing resumes. On a tier that adds frozen months to the commitment, the commitment end date moves out by the whole months frozen.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical tier with a shortest freeze of 30 and a longest freeze of 90 calendar days)

| Freeze requested | Within the length limits |
|---|---|
| 29 calendar days | No, shorter than 30 |
| 30 calendar days | Yes |
| 90 calendar days | Yes |
| 91 calendar days | No, longer than 90 |

## Further hypothetical cases

- A membership year counted from a start date of September 10 runs from one September 10 to the next; a tier allowing 1 freeze per membership year allows a single freeze in that span.
- A freeze covering the whole of March and the whole of April is two whole months frozen; on a tier that adds frozen months to the commitment, the commitment end date moves out by two months.
- A member whose membership is past due asks to freeze it: a freeze cannot be requested while dues are past due.
